title: Gujarat can sequence agriculture intervention in **4** stages from district diagnosis to institutionalized scale-up

phases.title: District diagnosis sets intervention priorities before resources are deployed
phases.body: Use district segmentation to identify where water stress, productivity gaps, and weaker market access coincide, then define the first implementation clusters.

phases.title: Pilot design translates priorities into targeted delivery models for each production system
phases.body: Build pilots around distinct needs in irrigated, rainfed, horticulture, and dairy-linked systems so delivery matches the operating conditions already seen across Gujarat.

phases.title: Cluster scale-up expands only the interventions that prove repeatable across similar districts
phases.body: Scale the strongest models through district clusters with comparable constraints, using the same sequencing logic rather than spreading effort uniformly statewide.

phases.title: Institutionalized delivery embeds proven interventions into routine state and partner execution
phases.body: Shift from pilot management to recurring execution through state systems, local partners, and monitoring routines so gains persist beyond the initial rollout.
